messages.subject: [R-SIG-Finance] Rolling Z-score trend indicator
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I find the pine library rolling z-score trend indicator by QuantAlgo very
useful.
While it is relatively straight forward to compute it I wonder if there is
a rolling z-score trend indicator (with plotting) library available
somewhere, pls?
TIA.

Regards,

--
Andr? Luiz Tietbohl Ramos, PhD
